title: Sabusuku Ikemen no Renai Shidou Dousei Tsuki tte Kiitemasen
titleRomaji: Sabusuku Ikemen no Renai Shidou Dousei Tsuki tte Kiitemasen
titleNative: サブスクイケメンの恋愛指導 同棲つきって聞いてません
synopsis: Anzu Nakamura is an office lady who is good at her job but no good at romance. One day, as she worries about what she will do if she ends up alone until she dies, her younger brother brings home his handsome friend, Iro Suzune! Iro says he has nowhere to go, so Anzu decides to let him stay the night, but ever since, Iro has strangely grown attached to her...? A love story woven between a worn-out office lady and a handsome man with a penchant for romance! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleRomaji: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei: Seisan-kei Majutsu de Na mo na Kimura wo Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni
titleEnglish: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleNative: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛 ～生産系魔術で名もなき村を最強の城塞都市に～
synopsis: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy…until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his “worthless” magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Anta Nante Daikirai
synopsis: Shizuka is your typical employee who can do work seriously and with accuracy. But he has an opposite side of himself, where his mouth smoothly speaks nothing but affectionate lines. He’s intoxicated by this side of himself that comes out only on the streets at night when he’s in the mood for love. One night, he meets Suzukuni, who has Shizuka’s ideal face and build. For Shizuka, he was just a one-night stand. While Shizuka tries to forget that amazing night, Suzukuni comes into his workplace, introducing himself as the acting president. (Source: Chronos)

Aren’t You Too Sweet Salt-God Sato-San?
The Salt-God Sato-san is only sweet to me!
คุณซาโต้ยอดนักเมิน เธอหวานใส่ผมแค่คนเดียว
The Cold Sato is Only Sweet to Me
synopsis: Satou-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer. Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat! Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

synopsis: For the love of all things otaku--anime, video games, figures, you name it! Power-pedaling Sakamichi Onoda has long been conquering the steepest slopes and regularly making the ninety-kilometer round-trip to Akihabara on a mommy bike!! Can this meek geek really out-pedal the future ace of the school road-racing team?! (Source: Yen Press)
